basis: Parameter importance for the out-of-sample Sharpe (daily, 2023-01-01..2026-11-09, Lab costs 0.05%+0.05% per side + funding) of Latin-hypercube samples over EVERY adjustable schema param, the same samples on every coin; Optuna fANOVA + model-free binned variance, mean and 90% bootstrap CI over coins; stability over coins and walk-forward fold years. recommended = plateau of the marginal OOS-Sharpe curve (only for the top params; null = keep the current default).
status: 4h+1d complete for rosyade_family, donchian_breakout, mean_reversion_range (24 coins each); lower TFs pending

labels.penting tapi tidak stabil: important but unstable across coins/years (show, warn)

prereg.trials: LHS trials only (space-filling, unbiased); target = fixed-config OOS Sharpe 2023-01..END; also per fold year and a live-only subset (>= 10 OOS trades)
prereg.methods: Optuna fANOVA (64 trees, seed 0) per coin; model-free: binned correlation ratio (5 quantile bins / categories) minus permutation-null mean (20 perms) per coin; mean and 90% bootstrap CI over coins
prereg.important: average normalised share of the two methods >= 2/d (d = number of dims) AND lower CI of the model-free excess > 0

labels.penting & stabil: important AND important in >= 50% of coins AND important in >= 2 of 3 fold years
labels.penting tapi tidak stabil: important but fails the coin or fold stability

prereg.interactions: top-6 params; pooled coin-demeaned target; 3x3-bin joint correlation ratio minus both main effects minus permutation null
prereg.curves: top-6 params; binned mean of the pooled (coin-demeaned + grand mean) OOS Sharpe with 90% bootstrap CI; plateau = contiguous bins around the best within max(10% of range, best-bin CI half-width)

recommended.basis: plateau of marginal OOS Sharpe (LHS samples, all coins)
